{{Quote|Ma'w'shiye and I have been training Rebel recruits in the use of high-powered blasters, but one thing that never ceases to amaze me is Barosa's simple slugthrower. That thing sounds like a Jexerian cannon when its fired.|Derembus Sitnalta, in a Rebel Task Force on Alliance Security SecuriDex file on Barosa Warren|<ref name="AIR">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref>}}
The '''Jexerian cannon''' was a primitive [[projectile cannon]] that emitted a notably loud noise when fired.<ref name="CSWE" /> It originated in<ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the Jexerian [[Cannon/Legends|cannon]]|system=[[Jexeria system/Legends|Jexeria system]]|legends=1}}</ref> the [[Jexeria system/Legends|Jexeria system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Tharin sector/Legends|Tharin sector]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> At some point by [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'' represents a collection of [[in-universe]] reports from "one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]," which corresponds to [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> in a personal addendum to a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Task Force on Alliance Security]] [[SecuriDex]] [[Datafile/Legends|datafile]] on [[Barosa Warren]], a former [[Morellian Enforcers|Morellian Enforcer]] and head of the [[Galactic Outdoor Survival School/Legends|Galactic Outdoor Survival School]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Derembus Sitnalta]], an Alliance [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] and a graduate of the Galactic Outdoor Survival School, compared the report made by Warren's [[.48-caliber Enforcer pistol]] when fired to that of a Jexerian [[Cannon/Legends|cannon]].<ref name="AIR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Jexerian cannon was first mentioned in ''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'', a [[1995]] sourcebook for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="AIR" />
